messages:
sam: quick flag anomaly — tenant `acme-co` reported a sudden routing revert to default pool without a matching console-audit entry. noticed during load test at ~14:17 UTC.

julia: ugh. which flag key? any trace IDs?

sam: flag `routing.v2.priority` for tenant acme-co. app traces show fallback log `route -> default` and trace id `t-0b7c`. console_audit search for that tenant/time returned nothing.

nate: could be the legacy agent overwrite path. we still have agent-side local-overrides enabled for 2% of customers for emergency ops. agent applies set a local-only value with endpoint `PUT /internal/agents/:id/flags` which intentionally didn't write to central audit. that was supposed to be phased out.

julia: we removed docs for that, but it shouldn't be used. any evidence it was called? request logs from edge-router show `X-Op-Source: agent-sync` for `t-0b7c`.

sam: yup, logs show POST to `/internal/agents/agg-sync` at 14:17:09 with body including `routing.v2.priority:false`. No audit.

nate: ok. plan: (1) immediate stop-gap: disable agent local-overrides for new applies (toggle flip) so future agent syncs return 403; (2) add reconciler to detect agent-only diffs and create an audit-backfill; (3) console UX: show an "Orphaned runtime change" banner with attach-evidence button.

julia: agree. who can flip the agent toggle? ops-bot:patch-perm?

ops-bot: Patch permissions: ops-team can change agent toggles. Use runbook `agent-toggle` to apply.

nate: I'll do the toggle now (will be a config change on the control-plane) and patch the agent binary to respect persist=true by default. ETA 1h for canary.

sam: for backfill, I propose a small tool `audit-backfill` that consumes reconciler diffs and emits `console_audit` records with metadata `source:reconciler, evidence:[trace_ids, agent_request_id]`. It should be idempotent (dedupe by evidence hash).

julia: yes make it idempotent. also the reconciler should surface priority: if drift_reason==agent-override then escalate to P1 if the runtime change reduces route capacity by >50%.

nate: telemetry: emit counter `reconciler_orphans_total{tenant,reason}` and a gauge `reconciler_pending_backfills`. Alert: `reconciler_pending_backfills > 0 for 10m` -> page.

sam: console UX: on orphaned change banner include two buttons: "Create audit record" (creates console_audit row) and "Revert runtime" (posts to runtime API to revert and attaches `X-Requested-By: console-reconcile`). The "Create audit" action should require a short justification note.

julia: add `X-Audit-Source: reconciler` and `X-Evidence-Hash` headers so the SDKs can correlate. Also add server-side validation to prevent creating audit rows with missing evidence.

nate: good. one more: update SDK apply call to return structured metadata headers when persist=false. Example response headers: ```X-Audit-Id: <uuid>\nX-Audit-State: pending|written|failed\nX-Audit-Retry-Token: <token>``` so callers can surface retry flows.

sam: will add to the incident note. creating INC-2025-342 with owners: nate (backend/reconciler), julia (console UX), sam (incident lead).

console-bot: Incident INC-2025-342 created: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2025-342 Priority P2.

julia: thanks. also let's schedule a postmortem checklist item: remove the legacy agent local-overrides feature entirely in Q1 2026, and add a migration path for customers who depend on it.

nate: noted. toggling now and kicking off a small canary run. will update thread with result (should be within 30m).

sam: appreciate it. if anyone from platform wants to pair on the reconciler design ping me.

julia: I'll draft console wireframes and API stubs tomorrow morning.

ops-bot: Note: agents will pick up the new control-plane toggle on next sync (poll interval 60s).
